title: Custom software, specialized workflows, and other new growth paths from SaaS Platform Summit
summary: SaaS platforms have long built for specific verticals. Now AI makes it practical to build for one merchant. At Stripe’s SaaS Platform Summit, founders and operators shared how custom software and embedded finance can open new revenue streams.

title: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
summary: Stripe Treasury now lets agents transfer funds, convert currencies, and pay vendors within limits you set. Give agents the access they need to help run your business, with customizable controls and human approvals.
